name: hero-v4-hit-death-readable
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Correct the supplied HIT/DEATH atlas layout and match the approved readable costume. Image1 supplies the SAME mature adult man and four reaction poses, but its narrow columns are faulty because falling/lying bodies cross them. Image2 is ONLY the approved identity/material/color reference: deep muted teal-green cape, dark cool-brown grainy leather, grey-brown long trousers, ivory linen sleeves, neutral brushed steel shoulder, naturally bright skin, small curly-haired adult head. No glossy cartoon plastic and no warm honey outfit. Keep7.7-8-head adult bone proportions, slim chest, high hip, long slim thighs and shins, realistic face and materials.
OUTPUT EXACTLY ONE SQUARE1536x1536 PNG, FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows. Each cell is384x384, wide enough for the SAME-SCALE full-body standing AND lying poses. Widen the OLD canvas columns, do NOT enlarge the figures just because there is more width. Upright people approx340-350px hair-to-sole with small heads about42px high. Same body pixel scale and same skull size in every cell, INCLUDING corpse. No per-pose miniaturization, leg shortening or skull enlargement. Do not scale a lying body's visible height to the standing height; keep actual anatomical lengths. Neutral level/slightly elevated orthographic view matching image2, not bird-eye.
ROWS exactly:1 front/down;2 right profile;3 back/up;4 left profile. COLUMNS exactly:0 HIT RECOIL, still standing tall with a small shoulder/chest reaction and open empty hands;1 STAGGER/LOSS OF BALANCE, a modest catching step and body tilt;2 FALLING TO GROUND, one hand and hip/side contacting ground, long readable legs;3 DEAD AND MOTIONLESS, eyes closed, full adult body resting on side/back, NOT standing/kneeling/sitting. No blood or gore needed. Keep clothing identity and camera side of the corresponding row. Preserve the old first/second reaction intent; redraw placement and later poses where necessary for a clean atlas.
STRICT ISOLATION: EVERY sprite's ENTIRE silhouette must fit inside its OWN384x384 cell with at least16px genuinely transparent margin on ALL sides. Max full-figure width and height352px; all hair, fingers, heels, toes, cape and belt sheath within that interior. Center each pose in its own cell. Standing contacts may sit near bottom y365; fallen/lying figures may lie horizontally or diagonally in the square, one knee very gently bent if needed, but retain long adult limbs and same scale. No body reaches past a cell boundary, no overlapping silhouettes, no neighboring body or spell fragment inside any other frame rectangle. In particular third-column hand/head/boot MUST NOT enter second/fourth column; fourth-column corpse must not enter third. Use the square space rather than shrinking a corpse or folding it into a ball.
ALL HANDS EMPTY in every cell. No exposed sword, bow, staff, shield or moving prop; a small fixed belt scabbard is allowed. Preserve ivory skin/cloth opacity. GENUINE fully transparent empty background and gaps around/between bodies, alpha0 where empty, clean fine silhouette/hair edges. No white/grey backdrop, floor, fog, vignette, glow, opaque ground shadows, checkerboard, grid lines, labels, text, numbers or UI. Only the sixteen human cutouts are nontransparent. Same readable palette as image2; no source-background colors copied. This is a production4x4 square sprite sheet, not an illustrated contact sheet on paper.
